title: Weighted matching · MPC

verifiedRecords.output: Matching edges, by setting every b_v=1
verifiedRecords.notes: d̄ is average degree. Theorem 5.1 states O(log log d̄ · exp(2^O(1/ε))) rounds and local Õ(n+poly(1/ε)) space.
assumptions: The weighted b-matching algorithm is specialized to b_v=1 for every vertex.
Output is an explicit matching of edges, with weight at least OPT_w/(1+ε).
Local memory is near-linear Õ(n), with ε fixed; this is not the strongly sublinear n^δ regime.
Total memory is Õ(m+n), with ε fixed.
Probabilistic guarantee and theorem formulas are inherited from the existing full-text-verified MPC record.
verifiedRecords.parameters: n vertices; m edges; d̄ is the average degree; fixed ε>0 in the main figure

coverageNote: One existing full-text-verified weighted MPC theorem, migrated from the mixed matching figure. This is a scoped baseline, not an exhaustive literature review.
lowerBoundStatus: No comparable lower bound is verified for this near-linear-memory contract. The reviewed CDP2024 conditional lower bound uses strongly sublinear local memory and is not plotted here.
axisNote: Axes are symbolic resource categories, not numerical distances or a fitted tradeoff curve. The main figure fixes ε; its full dependence remains in the theorem inspector.

sourceVerification.note: Reuses full-text verification from matching-mpc.json. The b_v=1 specialization yields ordinary weighted matching. No new source claim added.
